findings.label: Unlocked cross-task read (informational)
findings.detail: bigclock_lms_power_off is written under LOCK_O in process_aude and read without a lock in grfe_handler on a different task. For a single aligned bool carrying a level signal this is torn-read-free on xtensa and was explicitly accepted in the plan; volatile is optional, not required. No action needed.

findings.label: Bundled font changes
findings.detail: The working tree mixes the cold-start fix with pre-existing font/centering work in bigclock.c and gds_font.h plus untracked font files. Out of scope and harmless, but worth separating when staging.
